smoothterrain.settings.title: Smooth Terrain - Settings
smoothterrain.settings.movement_stable_h: Vanilla block collisions for reliable walking and jumping. Feet may sit above visible edges at high rounding values.
smoothterrain.settings.movement_experime: Collisions approximate the rounded terrain. Movement glitches may still occur at edges and during jumps.
smoothterrain.settings.save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
smoothterrain.blacklist.title: Block blacklist
smoothterrain.blacklist.no_match: No matches - tags can be added directly
smoothterrain.blacklist.empty: No additional ignored blocks or tags
smoothterrain.appearance.title: Appearance
smoothterrain.appearance.leaves_hint: All leaf species use the same smoothing. Blacklisted blocks stay original.
smoothterrain.appearance.logs_hint: Also affects logs used in buildings. Use the blacklist to protect them.
smoothterrain.appearance.snow_hint: Snow layers follow rounded terrain; disabled keeps original snow and ground contact.
smoothterrain.appearance.shores_hint: Round shore terrain and close its contact with the unchanged liquid mesh. Disabled uses exact shore anchors.
smoothterrain.appearance.grass_hint: Use the biome-tinted grass-top texture on non-snowy grass sides.
smoothterrain.appearance.all_hint: Includes building materials and trees. Terrain-only is the safer default; blacklist exclusions still apply.
